properties.name: Service Desk Agent
properties.description: Front-line support for the service desk.

properties.name: Problem Management
properties.description: The practice of identifying and understanding the underlying causes of an incident and identifying the best method to eliminate that root cause. Goes beyond finding and fixing incidents.

properties.name: Root Cause Analysis
properties.description: The process of identifying and understanding the underlying causes of an incident in order to eliminate the root cause.

properties.name: Incident Management
properties.description: The practice of finding and fixing incidents; closely related to problem management.

properties.name: Service Desk
properties.description: Front-line support structure for handling service requests and incidents.

properties.name: Service Health
properties.description: The ongoing operational health and reliability of the service, measured and reported by the Service Owner.

properties.name: Process Health
properties.description: The overall health and success of the problem management process, overseen by the Process Owner.

properties.name: Jira Service Management
properties.description: Atlassian's ITSM tool, part of the Service Collection, supporting problem management workflows.

properties.name: Problem Management Roles Text
properties.description: Extracted text describing problem management roles and responsibilities from Atlassian ITSM documentation.

properties.name: Tech Lead
properties.description: An individual familiar with the impacted service experiencing a problem or incident. Often a developer or engineer who can dive into recent code changes to identify root causes.
properties.also_called: Technical lead, subject matter expert, on-call engineer, developer, software developer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

properties.name: Adjacent Teams
properties.description: Teams outside the core problem management process who may need high-level information about problems.

properties.name: Problem Management
properties.description: The ITSM process for identifying, analyzing, and resolving the root causes of incidents and problems.

properties.name: Root Cause Analysis
properties.description: The process of identifying the underlying causes contributing to a problem or incident, often involving review of recent code changes.

properties.name: ITIL 4
properties.description: The latest version of the IT Infrastructure Library framework, described as more agile than previous versions.

properties.name: IT Change Management
properties.description: A process that minimizes risk while making changes to IT systems and services.

properties.name: Service Disruption Risk
properties.description: The risk of ongoing or recurring service problems and incidents if root causes are not identified and resolved.
